reason: This report documents a parameterised vehicle MODEL (carculator), not unit-process inventories. Its 91 tables are model parameters: mass distribution (Tab. 43), auxiliary power (Tab. 44), fleet composition (Tab. 45-48), degradation factors (Tab. 49), battery sizing (Tab. 50-51), energy consumption (Tab. 52) and powertrain-size combinations (Tab. 53), with the rest for buses and trucks. The only caption containing 'LCI' is Tab. 16, a list of datasets used to approximate PM emission composition. There is no table giving the per-kilometre exchanges of a passenger-car transport dataset, so the inventory exists only as model output, not as a locatable table.
